This imaging phenotype is classic for an IDH-mutant glioma and strongly argues against an IDH-wildtype glioma (glioblastoma), which typically occurs in older patients and presents with avid enhancement and central necrosis. The frontal and insular location is also a common site for IDH-mutant tumors. There are no imaging features to suggest an IDH-wildtype status.
